verified: Missing-field, short-row, invalid-numeric, unknown-sensor, invalid-timestamp, rejected-reading, successful, and failed-processing CSV audits pass the caller-owned connection and canonical location ID.
Synthetic rejected and successful CSV cases create only one connection, use the same connection for audit writes, and close it after the batch.
Failure details remain redacted to safe fixed messages or exception class names.
Raw numeric values and unknown device identifiers are not included in error messages or audit detail.
external_effects: CSV files were synthetic temporary fixtures; database writes and sensor projection were mocked. No database or provider was contacted.
limitations: No live PostgreSQL transaction or tenant authorization was exercised.
This does not establish full CSV ingestion parity with legacy data.
